title: Radiation and nuclear decay
design_rationale: Establish radiation identities and conservation before explaining beta decay particles and spectra.
concepts_taught: Compare the composition, mass and charge of alpha, beta-minus, beta-plus and gamma radiation.
Apply conservation of nucleon number and charge in alpha and beta decay equations.
Relate a particle to its antiparticle and identify the positron as the electron antiparticle.
Identify the neutrino or antineutrino emitted in beta decay.
Explain discrete alpha energies and the continuous beta energy range.

next_module_can_assume: Compare the composition, mass and charge of alpha, beta-minus, beta-plus and gamma radiation.
Apply conservation of nucleon number and charge in alpha and beta decay equations.
Relate a particle to its antiparticle and identify the positron as the electron antiparticle.
Identify the neutrino or antineutrino emitted in beta decay.
Explain discrete alpha energies and the continuous beta energy range.
next_module_must_not_assume: Quark flavours, hadrons and quark-level beta changes are deferred.
